## Failure paths and arms (fill in)

Run outside the chain on candidate 38a9927b (tree 2001cf2d), each on pristine or snapshot-rewound VMs (Ubuntu 24.04 manager+agent, Ubuntu 24.04 agent+log receiver, AlmaLinux 9 agent; Wazuh 4.14.0, 4.14.1 and 4.14.10 packages). All refusals were typed, and every refusal left the byte-identical host state (repo files, ossec.conf, client.keys, /etc/hosts, apt preferences, /var/backups/pilot, coordinator copy):

- Newer agent than manager (deb 4.14.10-1 and el 4.14.9-1 against a 4.14.1 manager): fim apply rc=2 at "Check installed and requested agent compatibility against the observed manager" with `installed Wazuh agent is newer than the observed manager`, changed=0. Control (agent equal to manager) passes.
- Older-but-compatible agent kept (deb 4.14.0-1, el 4.14.1-1): three applies, changed 10/9, then 0, then 0; fim verify PASS 20/0/0.
- Hold and versionlock oracles: `apt-mark showhold`, `apt-get -s upgrade`/`dist-upgrade`, `dnf versionlock list`, `dnf upgrade --assumeno`, explicit `dnf install wazuh-agent-4.14.10-1` blocked. Negative: after `apt-mark unhold` and `dnf versionlock delete`, verify FAIL 18/2 (C10); re-apply restores both with one changed task each and verify PASS 20/0/0.
- Manager refusals on an existing 4.14.1 stack (`wazuh_version` 4.14.9, 4.14.0, `wazuh_docker_version` 4.14.9, conflicting legacy inputs, malformed `4.14`): typed refusal, containers, image ids, StartedAt and compose hash unchanged. Partial stack (indexer stopped) and stopped Docker daemon are refused and not restarted.
- A registered, never-connected agent (id 007) blocks the manager gate with `unknown retained agent version in manager registry (agent ID 007)`; `manage_agents -r 007` restores a pass.
- External manager IP with the inventory manager present, and zero or two inventory managers: refused with a visible typed reason.
- Tag subsets on a pristine Debian agent (`--tags C10`, `--tags C5`, `--skip-tags C1`) are refused at the fresh-agent selection gate with no mutation; `--tags C1,C2` installs held without config; manager `--tags C12`, `--tags C1`, `--skip-tags C12` changed=0.
- Injected failure (stale registration so agent-auth fails): rescue ran (rescued=1), the managed ossec.conf block and the /etc/hosts pin were removed, the agent stayed installed and held, and the original failure was reported.
- EL under SELinux Enforcing: no AVC denial; five refused `agent-rpm-fresh` calls (foreign gpgkey, gpgcheck off, http scheme, `..` path, unreachable baseurl) left no private directory; a successful stage keeps `agent-policy-<token>` and an empty or populated `rpm-fresh-<token>`.
- Candidate 01038f1c (this record) is 38a9927b plus a test-only lint fix and a merge of main (5ee67130); the A playbooks, specs, contracts, helper scripts and topology are byte-identical to 38a9927b (all 57 closure files have identical blob and mode), so only the chain was re-run on 01038f1c (it passed with the same recaps and verdicts); the out-of-chain arms below were not repeated on it.
- Earlier candidate 1a251665 failed this chain at L4: the coordinator had no shebang and was executed by path (`Exec format error`, native run). That candidate is superseded; this record is the run of the fixed candidate.
- Control on main (a0d21395): a fresh install picks a Wazuh agent version (4.14.10-1) that is not bound to a 4.14.1 manager and has no hold.
